notes.title: Game-enhancing patch and 30% Discount!
notes.content:
Greetings Returners,

The Red Ego team heard your requests and is now proud to deploy its brand-new patch bringing enhancement into the current gameplay with few improvements, as well as fixing issues that impacted players’ experience. And most of all, a hint for the next game sequel.

Check out the changelog detailed below :

[list]
[*] Added a new scene after the final credits roll as a hint for the game sequel
[*] Added a new render mode in Settings to make the game playable in Old VHS Tv
[*] Saki is able to sprint from chapter 1 instead of chapter 7
[*] Moving from one scene to another doesn't require the player to re-press the direction button again
[*] Fixed the big ghost chase in chapter 8
[*] The inventory menu can start from the last item that was chosen/ picked when open the inventory
[*] Translated the character names and scenes
[*] Improved the Mini safe puzzle
[*] Changed the UI SFXs
[*] Improved the color and look of the PAST chapters
[*] Overall fixes and improvements
[/list]

And if this patch wasn't enough, we are also offering a week-long 30% discount so even more people will get the chance to play! 

The Red Ego Team
